mechanism: Fluconazole inhibits CYP3A4 and CYP2C19, potentially increasing lisdexamfetamine metabolism to active dexamfetamine and amphetamine metabolites, while also competing for renal clearance of amphetamines.
action: Monitor for increased stimulant effects (tachycardia, hypertension, tremor, insomnia); consider dose reduction of lisdexamfetamine or alternative antifungal if interaction symptoms emerge.
